name: Ember Kit
description: A fox-shaped cinder that never quite goes out. Naps in the hearth ash and follows whoever last fed it.

name: Mossback
description: Somewhere between a toad and a boulder. Slow, unbothered, and quietly load-bearing.

name: Glimmerwing
description: A moth the size of a hand, wings that catch light like stained glass. Circles the nearest lantern until it's carried off somewhere darker.

name: Packrat
description: Hoards anything shiny it can fit in its cheeks, including things that were not offered.

name: Ashwing
description: A crow that's taken a shine to the guild's rooftops. Turns up wherever something's about to be dropped, forgotten, or fed to it.

name: Rooftail
description: Spends most of the day curled along a rafter, tail wrapped twice around itself. Comes down for food and almost nothing else.

name: Tidewhelp
description: A pup-sized thing that's more sea-foam than fur. Leaves damp footprints on dry stone for reasons nobody's explained.

name: Wisplet
description: A drifting mote of pale light, barely warm to the touch. Settles on a shoulder and just stays there.

name: Hatchery Hound
description: Raised alongside the very first clutch the hatchery ever saved -- it still checks every new egg like it's personally responsible for them.

name: Black Dragonling
description: Small enough to perch on a shoulder, for now. Still lets out a puff of real smoke when startled, and has already learned that food arrives faster if it looks pitiful about asking.

name: Goldenpaw
description: Never once returned from a walk without something in its mouth -- a stick, a glove, occasionally somebody else's dinner. Entirely too pleased with itself about all of it.

name: Farwatch
description: Picks one spot near the door and holds it for hours, watching the horizon like something is definitely about to happen. Occasionally something does.

name: Longshadow
description: Takes up an entire doorway just standing in it. Moves like it has never once been in a hurry, and has apparently never needed to be.

name: Briarbeard
description: Looks personally offended by roughly one out of every three things that happen. The beard does most of the talking.

name: Frostrunner
description: Built for distances nobody here is actually travelling. Happiest mid-sprint for no particular reason, gone quiet and thoughtful the moment it has to stop.
